_README: Numbers quoted in the manuscripts that no results CSV or JSON contains, because they are
properties of the generator, the dataset file or the architecture rather than outputs of an
analysis. Each entry names what recomputes it. a36_number_sweep.py reads this file as a
declared source and reports how many tokens matched here rather than against a result file,
so the list itself stays auditable: an entry that stops being quoted, or a number that stops
being reproducible, shows up as a change in that count.
Verified on 2026-09-15 against dataset v10 by the commands in each 'verified_by' field.
